name: dominionstar-desktop
description: DominionStar Meet desktop application for Windows and macOS
author: DominionStar Leadership and Development

scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-v2.mjs && node scripts/test-bridge-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-capture-source.mjs && node scripts/test-capture-session.mjs && node scripts/test-desktop-layout.mjs && node scripts/test-desktop-session.mjs && node scripts/test-local-desktop-runtime.mjs && node scripts/test-host-stability-regressions.mjs && node scripts/test-desktop-google-oauth-return.mjs && node scripts/test-release-recovery.mjs && node scripts/test-release-health.mjs && node scripts/test-staged-rollout.mjs && node scripts/test-approved-share-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-approved-illustration-contract.mjs && node ../scripts/test-meet-toolbar-duplicates.mjs && node ../scripts/test-zoom-behavior-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-real-mac-regressions.mjs && node scripts/test-receiver-layout-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-slide-control-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-video-quality-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-video-intelligence-compositor.mjs
scripts.dist:windows: npm run clean && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/apply-staged-rollout.mjs 10 dist/latest.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never && node scripts/apply-staged-rollout.mjs 10 dist/latest-mac.yml

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses your camera when you choose to join a meeting with video.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses your microphone when you choose to speak in a meeting.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: DominionStar Meet uses system audio only when you explicitly choose to include computer sound in a screen share.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: DominionStar Meet uses screen capture only when you choose to share your screen.
